# Preliminary proposal: Internal regulation Q&A assistant

## Context
Employees wait two days on average for answers about internal regulations.

## Proposed solution
A RAG-based Q&A assistant over ~800 documents, answering with citations.

## Estimated effort
| Phase | Person-days |
|---|---|
| PoC | 10–15 |
| MVP | 30–50 |
| Production | 60–100 |

## Assumptions
- Documents are text-based, no OCR needed.

## Risks
- Wrong clause cited (level 4): citations are mandatory.
